# Riccardo Giannetto Photography

Nature and wildlife photography portfolio and blog by Riccardo Giannetto. Focus: landscapes, wildlife, birds, and macro details of the natural world, shot with an ethical, non-intrusive approach (observe without interfering, respect distances and habitats). Contact: rgiannetto@gmail.com.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.riccardogiannetto.com/): Photo gallery grid, latest work.
- [About](https://www.riccardogiannetto.com/pages/about): Bio, photography approach and ethics.
- [Map](https://www.riccardogiannetto.com/map): Interactive map of photo shoot locations (GPS-tagged).
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.riccardogiannetto.com/pages/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.riccardogiannetto.com/pages/cookies)

## Photo categories

- natura (nature)
- paesaggio (landscape)
- Puffin (puffins)

## Sample photos

Each photo page (`/p/{slug}`) shows a single image with title, tags, camera/lens EXIF data, GPS location, and date.
